summary: Completed testing of Prazo debts store separation, WhatsApp charge features, and PIX verification flow. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend verified working with correct store separation.
passed_tests: Backend: 18/18 tests passed
GET /api/prazo/debts?store=runner - Returns only Runner store debts
GET /api/prazo/debts?store=gym-londres - Returns only GYM Londres store debts
GET /api/prazo/debts - Returns all stores debts with store_filter='all'
Store separation totals match: Runner + GYM Londres = All
POST /api/prazo/charge-customer/{name} - Returns error for non-existent customer
POST /api/prazo/charge-customer/{name} - Endpoint exists and responds correctly
POST /api/prazo/charge-all-whatsapp?store=runner - Charges Runner customers only
POST /api/prazo/charge-all-whatsapp?store=gym-londres - Charges GYM Londres customers only
PIX orders start with pending_payment status
POST /api/orders/{store}/{id}/auto-verify-pix - Endpoint exists
POST /api/orders/{store}/{id}/pix-proof - Proof upload works
GET /api/whatsapp/status - Returns bot status
GET /api/stores - Returns both stores
GET /api/kitchen/{store}/stats - Works for both stores
GET /api/prazo/customers - Returns prazo customers list
Create Runner prazo order - Correctly assigned to runner store
Create GYM Londres prazo order - Correctly assigned to gym-londres store
Store separation verified - TEST_Runner_Prazo only in Runner, TEST_GYM_Prazo only in GYM Londres
Frontend: Runner Kitchen Prazo tab shows R$102.00 with 2 customers (Gustavo, TEST_Runner_Prazo)
Frontend: GYM Londres Kitchen Prazo tab shows R$51.00 with 2 customers (Gustavo, TEST_GYM_Prazo)
Frontend: TEST_Runner_Prazo NOT visible in GYM Londres (correct store separation)
Frontend: PIX tab shows pending orders with AI verification status
Frontend: 'Verificar manualmente ou Tentar IA' button present for PIX verification
Frontend: 'Cobrar Todos' and 'Novo Cliente' buttons present in Prazo tab
seed_data_creation: TEST_Runner_Prazo and TEST_GYM_Prazo orders created for testing store separation
context_for_next_testing_agent: All prazo store separation features verified working: 1) /api/prazo/debts?store=runner returns only Runner debts, 2) /api/prazo/debts?store=gym-londres returns only GYM Londres debts, 3) KitchenPage.js fetches prazo debts with store parameter, 4) WhatsApp charge-customer endpoint sends to customer phone number, 5) WhatsApp charge-all-whatsapp accepts store parameter for filtering, 6) PIX verification flow shows AI status and manual verification options, 7) WhatsApp groups configured: Runner=5511974449533-1572969909@g.us, GYM Londres=120363424613813278@g.us

prazo_store_separation.details: Prazo debts correctly filtered by store. Runner shows R$102.00, GYM Londres shows R$51.00. TEST_ prefixed customers appear only in their respective stores.

whatsapp_charge_customer.details: POST /api/prazo/charge-customer/{name} sends WhatsApp message to customer's phone number. Returns error if customer has no phone or no debts.

whatsapp_charge_all.details: POST /api/prazo/charge-all-whatsapp?store={store} filters customers by store before sending charges.

pix_verification.details: PIX orders show in PIX tab with AI verification status. 'Tentar IA' button for retry, 'Aprovar'/'Recusar' for manual approval.

whatsapp_group_config.details: WHATSAPP_GROUP_RUNNER and WHATSAPP_GROUP_ID configured in backend/.env. Store-to-group mapping in STORE_WHATSAPP_GROUPS dict.

kitchen_prazo_tab.details: Kitchen page Prazo tab fetches debts with store parameter. Shows 'Cobrar Todos', 'Novo Cliente' buttons and individual charge buttons.

whatsapp_configuration.notification_flow: PIX verification only sends WhatsApp notification if is_valid=true (auto_approved=true)
